meta.authority: sr01_spec.json wins over every number here

assets.SK_SR01: rigged skeletal rifle, scope NOT included (+ _LOD1..3, SK_SR01_Skeleton, PHYS_SR01, clips A_SR01_*)
assets.SM_SR01: static twin: bipod FOLDED (the sheet pose), riser at the sheet pose, magazine merged (study Q3 default); scope not included
assets.SM_Att_Scope_LongRange: scope + its two rings, static attachment on Rail_Top (own Mount, Sight sockets; body + lens slots)
assets.optional_SM_SR01_Deployed: not built in v1 (Q5): a static twin with the bipod deployed for set dressing

frame.origin: Grip (computed in the spec: 46 mm down the grip axis from the web line)

table.head: bolt face centre on the bore axis at rest
table.motion: rotate about X 0..-60 deg (handle up), then translate -X 0..88 mm; the translation only at -60

table.head: trigger pivot
table.motion: rotate about Y 0..+6 deg (lower end rearward)

table.head: safety pivot pin
table.motion: rotate about Y: FIRE 0 (bind) / SAFE -12 deg (lever tip rearward)

table.head: paddle pivot pin
table.motion: rotate about Y 0..press (spec; pad forward, hook rearward)

table.parent: body (proposal P1; the standard lists only 'stock')
table.head: riser plate bottom centre at rest
swivel axis point under the clamp
table.motion: rotate about X -15..+15 deg (cant), 0 in every clip

table.head: hub axis at the left leg (Y +19.5)
table.motion: rotate about Y 0 (folded forward) .. +90 deg (deployed down)

table.head: hub axis at the right leg (Y -19.5)
collar centre
table.motion: translate +X (leg's rest axis) 0..76 mm in 19 mm detents

bones.skeleton_sharing: the AR-01 pilot's bones body, bolt, trigger, selector, mag_release, magazine, muzzle_device keep their names, parent and axes (bolt -X; trigger, selector, mag_release about Y); SK_SR01_Skeleton lists SK_AR01_Skeleton as compatible; the bolt's extra rotation about X and the bipod / riser bones are driven by the sniper's own clips or by ABP nodes that do nothing on other guns (U2b)
bones.abp_angle_table: bolt_rotate 0..-60, bolt 0..88, trigger 0..6, selector detents [0, -12], release 0..press, bipod_legs 0..90, bipod_ext 0..76, riser -12.9..12.0

sockets.gun_note: no Sight on the gun: no iron sights are drawn, the scope's Sight overrides (study 5.3); BoltHandle is the optional hand target (study ChargingHandle analogue, named for the part; PascalCase, deny-list clean); BipodFoot_L/R on the _ext bones for ground IK; SupportHandBipod = the off-hand under the butt when prone

clips.motion: bolt rotate 0 -> -60 (f0-6), slide 0 -> 88 (f6-14), hold (f14-16), slide back 88 -> 0 (f16-24), rotate -60 -> 0 (f24-30); safety at FIRE
paddle press, mag straight down along -Z, drop; new mag up the path, paddle release, hook snaps into the notch; bolt closed throughout
bolt open (rotate -60, slide 88: starts_at_rest false), mag change as Reload, then bolt forward and down
legs 0 -> +90 (f0-12, left leads by 2 frames: independent legs), detent click; ext 0 -> 38 (f16-30, both, the collar button pressed); cant 0
ext 38 -> 0 (f0-14), legs +90 -> 0 (f18-32), detent click; ends at the bind pose

lods.rule: measured LOD-pop on the final engine bounds incl. the bounds extension (folded and deployed)

SK_SR01: M_SR01_Metal (M_Steel_Master: barrel, device, bolt, receiver, rail, small steel parts, bipod steel)

M_SR01_Chassis (M_Fabric_Master, Metal From ORM ON: OD Cerakote over aluminium with bare-metal wear, plus the non-recolourable rubber pad, polymer grip, anodized bipod body and rubber feet with Masks A = 0)
slots.SM_SR01: Metal on U tile 0, Chassis on tile 1, merged mag on tile -1: 3 slots, the qa_check limit (study 5.8)
SM_SR01_Mag: M_SR01_Mag (M_Fabric_Master + MFO: phosphated steel body, polymer floorplate)
slots.held_draw_calls: gun 2 x 2 + mag 2 x 1 + scope 2 x 2 = 10 (the study's <= 10 with attachments)
SM_Att_Scope_LongRange: M_Att_Scope_Body (M_Steel_Master: anodized black + rubber eyecup baked)

texture_sets.Chassis: 4096 likely (largest painted area incl. pad, grip, bipod body; class B comb/riser/action bed)
texture_sets.rule: smallest power of two holding the classes at fill >= 70/65 % (packer decides; x2.3 estimate factor)

bounds_extension: envelope over LOD0-3 x every clip frame x bipod folded/deployed x ext 0..76 x cant +-15 x riser range x bolt open/back (B11)
gunlib_proposals: P2 bipod motion axes in the standard
P4 attachment socket table (Mount, Sight, EyePoint, Lens_Front) + scope standard
P6 bolt rotate-then-slide in rig.key_action helpers
P9 TOP-view floor-shadow edge method into the shared trace helpers
